item.title: After 6 months of war, Iran's battered regime remains entrenched
item.description: Instead of collapsing, the Iranian regime has dug in its heels and taken an even harder line.

item.title: Experts warn more flooding might hit Nepal. And, Fed chairman to give key address
item.description: As the death toll rises from flash floods that hit the Nepal-Tibet border, experts are warning more flooding could be on the way. And, Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh is expected to give a key address today.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Hundreds killed, over 1,000 missing after flash floods in Nepal and Tibet
item.description: Hundreds of people were killed by devastating flash floods that hit the Nepal-Tibet border, sweeping away roads, bridges and entire villages. More than 1,000 people are still missing.
item.content:encoded: Hundreds of people were killed by devastating flash floods that hit the Nepal-Tibet border, sweeping away roads, bridges and entire villages. More than 1,000 people are still missing.

item.title: 'It's essentially been one long day': A daughter details search for parents in Nepal
item.description: Shreya Ahuja is searching for her parents after devastating floods struck Nepal. She is calling for international help and communications access as her family waits for news.

item.title: A melting glacier contributed to the deadly Nepal floods. We can expect more like this
item.description: As the climate continues to warm, scientists warn that the frequency of disasters like the floods in Nepal will increase.

item.title: U.S. says pipelines will make Strait of Hormuz irrelevant. Energy experts disagree
item.description: Treasure Secretary Scott Bessent said oil pipelines will make Strait of Hormuz irrelevant in two years. Energy experts say that is unlikely to happen.

item.title: Norway's King Harald V dies at 89 and his son becomes King Haakon VIII
item.description: King Harald V of Norway, who went into exile in the United States as a child during the Nazi occupation of his homeland and refused a string of European noblewomen to marry his school sweetheart, died Friday.

item.title: Helicopter pilot describes what he's seen rescuing people in Nepal
item.description: Andy Thapa is a charter and rescue pilot for a Nepali helicopter company. He's been rescuing people stranded by the catastrophic flooding, and carrying them to safety.
